firstPlayerRule: The player using Miss Scarlet takes the first turn. Play then passes to the player on the left.
clarifications: Miss Scarlet is the red suspect token; the first player is determined by that role, not by a roll.
interpretation: The first-player rule applies to the classic edition represented by this Hasbro instruction sheet.
